intro.text: A brightlord and Shardbearer from Thanadal's princedom, a Flamestance duelist with a Shardblade but no Plate.

items.text: Dalinar and Adolin hoped to shame Sadeas's faction by winning their Shards in duels, and Adolin's friend Jakamav suggested Salinor, who often boasted that he was better than his ranking. To get him to agree, Adolin had to wager both his Blade and his Plate against Salinor's Blade alone.

Salinor borrowed a set of the King's Plate for the duel. Adolin dropped his usual Windstance for a brutal Ironstance and broke tradition without breaking any rule, so Highlady Istow had to give him the win. Salinor refused to hand over his Blade until Adolin threatened him; Adolin gave it to his brother Renarin.
Adolin had hoped that beating Salinor would make other Shardbearers keener to duel him, but it didn't.
